verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native scheduling. What it does show is that collections can be run from the Postman CLI and Newman, and plugged into CI/CD pipelines through the CLI and Postman API. That means recurring runs are only possible by leaning on an external scheduler such as a CI cron job. The visual API-workflow tool is mentioned, but nothing says it can be scheduled. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring runs (e.g. monitors or scheduled collection runs), scheduling of visual workflows, documentation of schedule configuration, independent corroboration.
